mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 220, it signals elevated inflation that triggers central bank tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 220, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) below 600 and 390000, respectively, indicates broad consumer demand weakness, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 7.0%), the Federal Reserve maintains low interest rates, boosting equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 7.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 signals manufacturing contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 95.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 600 signals weak consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when HOUST < 600, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A strong labor market (PAYEMS > 130000) signals robust consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS > 130000, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 and housing starts (HOUST) below 600 indicates a broad economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
